title: Dentsply Sirona Manufactures 100,000th Heliodent Plus X-Ray Unit
html:
The 100,000-unit milestone reflects decades of clinician trust and the growing importance of connected imaging workflows in modern dentistry.

Dentsply Sirona has manufactured its 100,000th Heliodent® Plus intraoral X-ray unit at its Bensheim, Germany, facility, marking a significant milestone for one of the world’s most widely adopted intraoral imaging platforms.

The achievement comes as dental practices around the globe continue to embrace connected digital workflows, with intraoral imaging remaining a foundational component of diagnosis, treatment planning, and patient communication. Today, Heliodent Plus systems are installed in practices across more than 115 countries and support clinicians in delivering diagnostic imaging to millions of patients each year.

“Heliodent Plus has remained relevant because it continues to meet a real need in daily dentistry: reliable intraoral imaging that fits naturally into the practice workflow,” said Johannes Krug, VP of Connected Technology Solutions at Dentsply Sirona. “We are proud to support clinicians with a solution they can depend on every day—one that helps practices work efficiently, make confident decisions, and deliver quality care to patients around the world.”

A Foundation for Digital Dentistry

Introduced in 2009 as a digitally ready successor to a product lineage dating back to the 1940s, Heliodent Plus was designed to meet the evolving needs of modern dental practices. The system delivers high-quality intraoral imaging, flexible installation options, and seamless integration with Dentsply Sirona’s Sidexis imaging software.

Over the past 15 years, the platform has undergone continuous refinement to support evolving clinical and workflow requirements while maintaining the reliability practices depend on every day.

As practices increasingly seek connected technologies that streamline workflows and improve collaboration, intraoral imaging remains a critical entry point into the digital ecosystem.

Built in Germany. Trusted Worldwide.

Every Heliodent Plus unit has been manufactured at Dentsply Sirona’s Bensheim facility, where decades of expertise in dental imaging continue to support the needs of clinicians around the world.

Over the years, generations of engineers, technicians, and manufacturing teams have contributed to the development and production of intraoral imaging systems from the same site, creating a legacy of reliability and continuous innovation.

“The 100,000th Heliodent Plus is a milestone we are proud to celebrate—not only because of the number, but because of what it represents: decades of manufacturing excellence in Bensheim and the continued trust of dental professionals worldwide,” said Ted Julius, vice president of Supply Chain, Connected Technology Solutions.

For more information about Dentsply Sirona’s X-ray solutions, please visit Dentsply Sirona X-ray Solutions.

About Dentsply Sirona

Dentsply Sirona is the world’s largest diversified manufacturer of professional dental products and technologies, with over a century of innovation and service to the dental industry and patients worldwide. Dentsply Sirona develops, manufactures, and markets a comprehensive solutions offering including dental and oral health products as well as other consumable medical devices under a strong portfolio of world-class brands.

Dentsply Sirona’s innovative products provide high-quality, effective and connected solutions to advance patient care and deliver better and safer dental care. Dentsply Sirona is headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. The Company’s shares are listed in the United States on Nasdaq under the symbol XRAY.

Visit www.dentsplysirona.com for more information about Dentsply Sirona and its products.
